Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Overview
Libraries happen to be the heart of educational institutions .The edifice building of Central Library of AWKUM was inaugurated by the Amir Haider Khan Hoti on 7
th
Sep, 2012. The eye catching building is located at the centre of the university which can accommodate 200,000 books on its shelves. This well furnished building of the library qualifies all the dimensions of the modern and state of the art libraries as it has been equipped with all the modern day facilities and services. Library has the great antitheft system of RFID (Radio Frequency Identification system). Library is fully automated, having the facility of OPAC.
